name: Grand Hyatt Tokyo
accessSummary: Roppongi Station (Tokyo Metro Hibiya Line) Exit 1C: 3 min walk / Roppongi Station (Toei Oedo Line) Exit 3: 6 min walk

rooms.note: Boardroom: 36. The banquet 40 and standing buffet 60 capacities apply when Thyme C, D and E are used.

rooms.name: 4F Thyme - 2 Rooms
rooms.note: Boardroom: 24. The banquet 30 and standing buffet 40 capacities apply when Thyme D and E are used.

rooms.name: 4F Lavender - 2 Rooms
rooms.note: Boardroom: 20. Only the combinations A+B or C+D.

rooms.name: 4F Lavender - 1 Room
rooms.note: Boardroom: 8. Only for A or B.

ops.catering: Bringing in food (including coffee) is prohibited (Banquet Terms and Conditions). Decoration, flowers, sound, lighting, entertainment and the like are arranged by the hotel through its designated contractors. If you want to use another company, the hotel's prior approval is required; load-in, load-out, installation location and installation time follow the hotel's instructions, and if the hotel decides its staff need to be present, a separate attendant labor fee is charged.
ops.waitingRooms: There is a changing room (CHANGING ROOM) on the banquet floor (floor map).
ops.restaurants: The in-house restaurants offer private-room and full-buyout party plans; the official page presents them as private-room and full-buyout plans usable for receptions, appreciation parties, press parties and the like. The restaurants covered are Oak Door, French Kitchen, Roku-ryoku (六緑), Shunbo (旬房), Keyakizaka, China Room and Maduro.
